copy.heading: Time
copy.subheading: What "a quick nine" means to everybody else, and how to read a calendar that is not the fixture list.
body: Golf time runs at a different speed from family time. A round that feels like three hours to you has lasted most of a day for the people at home. This stage is about the gap between the two, and how to close it.

illustration.concept: Dave walking in through the front door in the dark, bag on his shoulder, cheerfully raising a hand in greeting, while behind him the kitchen clock shows twenty to nine and a plate of dinner sits under cling film.
